checks: Exact rotating mirror order and full matrix
Frozen driver, all source files, libraries, source manifests, logs and CSV hashes
Zero read bytes, swaps or major faults in measured resident phases
Processes execute serially inside recorded machine-lock interval
Successful scratch cleanup validated; deleted fixture hash cannot be independently re-read

uncertainty_method: Arithmetic mirror-pair mean within each block; 95% Student t interval on three block log ratios (df=2). Pointwise intervals, no multiple-comparison adjustment; no samples excluded.
limitations: One worker pinned to CPU 2; final confirmation covers point and long-range resident reads only. Earlier wider pilot covers short ranges and eight-worker reads.
Cache128MiB, 200k 24/100-byte tuples, memtable4MiB, zero background workers, WAL disabled; full warm scan plus3s warmup before8s phases; one excluded30s-per-phase precondition.
Observational before/after thermal and frequency readings are not timed frequency or throttle measurements; laptop DVFS and serial phase order remain possible confounders.
Only three independent blocks; intervals do not establish a universal 2-3% performance bound.
CPU seconds and wall seconds in raw query CSV are rounded to milliseconds; rates are printed separately.

Process write_bytes is0 or4096 in measured phases. The driver logs watchdog progress during measurement, so these process totals include diagnostic output and are not evidence of database writes. Timed read_bytes is zero in every sample.
